positions.title: Summer Scholar

positions.description: Initially I worked as a contractor for their web development needs, before their launch. I then worked exploring methods to improve their client side, through the use of coffee script and chaplin.js.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Just finshished highschool I decided I would spend my summer helping some friends out with their new startup. I woked with them using django to develop some frontend stuff in addition to some internal development tools with git.

projects.title: National Computer Science School (NCSS)
projects.description: NCSS is a program offered to talented high school computing students that takes place over several days at the University of Sydney. During this time I built a python templating engine.

projects.title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2012
projects.description: My team got to the national finals in the Imagine Cup competition in Australia working on a system that allowed charities to better pool their resources in distributing their food supplies, by allowing them to communicate with each other more effectively and providing some hints on routing (obviously you hit the P = NP wall pretty hard because it is a variant of travelling salesman, but you avoid this by providing good enough paths).
